semantic.justification: Original selected UNIX SvFileStream constructors/destructor, IO/error/unsigned sentinel, seek/resize/sync, URL/system-path conversion, stat/temporary mode, symlink replacement, readonly retry, internal share table and close/reset order are implemented over actual OSL/MEMFS and native std::mutex with consumed unique_lock. Source F_RDLCK=0, path-vs-URL lookup bypass, original requested mode after readonly retry, silent table denial, ignored copy failure and unsigned cursor advancement remain unchanged. JS owners/buffers stay GC-managed; UNO sequence bytes are marshalled at the native IO boundary, no stream/syscall provider or private-state injection. The canonical include/tools/stream.hxx boundary now exposes actual byte/memory/file owners; native wrappers consume that header. SvStream captures real thread encoding on construction and exposes original encoding/mode accessors. Full TempFile service/storage/package/model/filter/UI, native thread races, pointer ordering/ABI/OOM/invalid spans and downstream tools XPath/XmlWalker owner tests remain incomplete or unqualified.
